name: Algorithm pseudocode
description: A numbered, captioned algorithm float with Require/Ensure, a loop, a condition and a return.
notes: `[1]` after `algorithmic` numbers every line. Use `[0]` for none.
Keywords end with an explicit `\EndFor`, `\EndIf`, `\EndWhile` (algpseudocode style).
Use `\gets` for assignment (←). It reads better than `=`.
